scripts.test: rm -rf .tmp-test && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir .tmp-test && node --test .tmp-test/packages/cli/test/*.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .tmp-test; exit $status
scripts.render: trap 'rm -rf .tmp-cli' EXIT; rm -rf .tmp-cli && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir .tmp-cli && node .tmp-cli/packages/cli/src/cli.js
